simple.meaning: עֲבִידָה (ʻăbîydâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “labor or business.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:24. Its contexts include kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲבִידָה (H5673).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

majorEvents.label: Divine acceptance
majorEvents.evidenceText: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, and don’t worship the golden image which you have set up.”

timeline.evidenceText: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.
Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.
They set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.
Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon; but Daniel was in the king’s gate.

There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, and don’t worship the golden image which you have set up.”
